spoilers.title.description: Settings root row title (a switch): hides what an unwatched episode would give away. Short.

spoilers.detail.value: Blur unwatched episodes and hide their descriptions.
spoilers.detail.description: Detail line under the Spoiler protection row on the Settings root. One short sentence.

spoilers.hidden.value: Description hidden. Press OK to show.
spoilers.hidden.description: Replaces an unwatched episode's description while Spoiler protection is on, where OK reveals it. OK is the remote's select key.

spoilers.hidden_short.description: Replaces an unwatched episode's description while Spoiler protection is on, where nothing on this screen reveals it.
